metrics.wfr_note: WFA engine does not output IS (training) Sharpe — WFR cannot be computed. Use aggregate OOS Sharpe (0.528) as primary metric.

data_fix.issue: First WFA attempt failed because data.min_required_bars (2000) was used for min_bars_per_window, but first window only had 720 validation bars (2000 required).
data_fix.fix: Changed data.min_required_bars from 2000 to 600 in wfa_config.yaml.
data_fix.lesson: data.min_required_bars controls min_bars_per_window in the runner — must match walk_forward.min_bars_per_window (600).

lessons: EMA Trend Gate on ETH produces 14.3 avg trades/window — far more than vol_adaptive_trend BTC (4.3 trades/window), validating ETH's higher volatility for frequent signals.
Aggregate OOS Sharpe of 0.528 falls below the 0.8 gate. Per-window Sharpe median is -0.024 with only 49% positive windows — borderline result.
4h EMA regime filter (ema4h_period=50 pinned) combined with 1h RSI pullback (rsi_oversold=35, rsi_overbought=65) is a stable parameter set.
Hold_bars parameter is highly unstable (CV=0.545) — different windows prefer very different exit horizons. WFA selects 24-96 range across windows.
WFA engine does not output IS Sharpe — WFR cannot be computed. This is a data gap in the engine's output format.
Critical config bug found and fixed: data.min_required_bars (2000) overrides walk_forward.min_bars_per_window (600) in the smoke test runner. This caused the first WFA attempt to skip all 85 windows.
The strategy underperforms pure unfiltered RSI on BTC (0.94 Sharpe) — the 4h regime filter may be too restrictive, filtering out valid mean-reversion opportunities.
7.5 years of ETH data (64,733 hourly bars) across 85 WFA windows provides the most statistically robust result in the factory to date.
next_actions: Test EMA Trend Gate on BTC with same parameters to compare vs ETH performance
Try wider RSI bands (rsi_oversold 25-35, rsi_overbought 65-75) to increase signal frequency
Test without 4h regime filter (pure RSI pullback on ETH) as comparison baseline
Fix WFA engine to output IS Sharpe for WFR computation
Consider shorter optimization windows (2mo train/1mo test) to increase number of windows
